title: Recently Added and device activity
summary: Jellydash now brings new library arrivals to Now Playing, adds a lightweight device activity view to Statistics, and makes the interface more polished and easier to use.
highlights: Browse movies, series, and episodes added during the last 14 days from the new Recently Added shelf on Now Playing.
See registered Jellyfin clients, recent device activity, active playback, client versions, and last users inside Statistics.
Open Jellyfin's device management page directly from the new Devices section.
Turn Recently Added off from Settings if you prefer a simpler Now Playing page.
Notice unsaved settings immediately with a save reminder that stays within reach.
Enjoy clearer Tabler icons throughout the interface, plus improved mobile layouts for playback cards, Recently Added, and the statistics footer.
